### Evidence Description
Description of the trace table, proof sketch, or benchmark experiment being documented per Brief Section 10.

### Deliverable Category
- [ ] Trace Table (Binary Search / Insertion Sort / Merge-Quick Sort / Dijkstra / Kruskal-Prim / DP)
- [ ] Proof Sketch (Loop Invariant / Recursion-Induction / Greedy-DP Correctness)
- [ ] Counterexample (Greedy Failure / Invalid Precondition)
- [ ] Benchmark CSV & Plotted Runtime Graphs

### Verification Checklist
- [ ] Uses real data parameters from Ghana Hospital dataset
- [ ] Documented in `docs/trace-tables/` or `docs/proof-sketches/`
- [ ] Reviewed by Pod 7 / Integration Lead
